cond_0001.intro: As a member of the [Company name masked] research support services team, responsible for the clinical nursing care of research subjects as they undergo procedures related to their study participation. Support the Center's mission of providing the highest quality service to the clinical investigators and study participants, work collaboratively with research support staff, clinical investigators and administration to ensure the professional and accurate performance of participant education, protocol-directed activities, and data collection, while working directly in a nursing capacity including the performance of essential clinical skills, which must be current within one year, with the study participants.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Evaluates and assesses subject's suitability for inclusion in studies; develops and modifies procedures according to study findings; recommends changes to the study protocol to coincide with study goals and objectives.
Develops and implements procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Contributes to designing activities, policies and procedures to improve day to day efficiency of the recruitment and assessment components of the study and to ensure that staff members perform activities within established research protocol.
Arranges patient enrollment, determines patient eligibility and obtains informed consent.
Develops study subject referral sources; designs and develops outreach programs.
Collaborates with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegates tasks and supervises the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants. Current clinical skills to include physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations. Ability to work independently, display excellent communication skills.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent and pediatric study subjects when needed, transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol, when necessary. Prepares specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance, when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion. Proven ability with maintaining accurate, timely and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection with adaptability in Epic as well as other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task with a high level of proficiency. Demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations.
Computer skills including familiarity with internet.
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience in clinical research.
Previous experience in interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.

cond_0278.responsibilities:
Evaluate and assess subjects' suitability for inclusion in studies; determine and modify procedures based on study findings; recommend protocol changes to align with study goals and objectives.
Develop and implement procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Lead the design of activities, policies, and procedures to improve day-to-day efficiency of recruitment and assessment, and ensure staff perform activities within established research protocol.
Direct patient enrollment, determine patient eligibility, and obtain informed consent.
Develop study subject referral sources; design and execute outreach programs.
Lead coordination with multidisciplinary researchers to integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0278.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in the State of [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Current clinical skills including physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration, and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations.
Ability to work independently and display excellent communication skills.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent, and pediatric study subjects when needed; transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol; prepare specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion.
Proven ability maintaining accurate, timely, and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection, with adaptability in Epic and other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize, and multi-task with a high level of proficiency; demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations.
Computer skills including familiarity with the internet.
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience in clinical research.
Previous experience interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.

cond_0327.intro: As a member of the [Company name masked] research support services team, responsible for the clinical nursing care of research subjects as they undergo procedures related to their study participation. Support the Center's mission of providing the highest quality service to the clinical investigators and study participants, work collaboratively with research support staff, clinical investigators and administration to ensure the professional and accurate performance of participant education, protocol-directed activities, and data collection, while working directly in a nursing capacity including the performance of essential clinical skills, which must be current within one year, with the study participants.
cond_0327.responsibilities:
Evaluates and assesses subject's suitability for inclusion in studies; develops and modifies procedures according to study findings; recommends changes to the study protocol to coincide with study goals and objectives.
Develops and implements procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Contributes to designing activities, policies and procedures to improve day to day efficiency of the recruitment and assessment components of the study and to ensure that staff members perform activities within established research protocol.
Arranges patient enrollment, determines patient eligibility and obtains informed consent.
Develops study subject referral sources; designs and develops outreach programs.
Collaborates with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegates tasks and supervises the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0327.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in [Location masked] or eligible for licensure there.
Around four years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of clinical skills including physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration, and basic emergency management; ALS or BLS and AED certification required (must be current within one year).
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically in line with HIPAA and HIC regulations.
Familiarity with Epic and other electronic data capture systems, with openness to building adaptability across platforms.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion.
Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple tasks; willingness to develop problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations, or demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.
Computer skills including familiarity with the internet.
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience in clinical research.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent, and pediatric study subjects; experience transporting specimens to and from clinical laboratories and preparing specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance.
Some exposure to interpreting clinical physiologic data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.

cond_0416.responsibilities:
Evaluates and assesses subject's suitability for inclusion in studies; develops and modifies procedures according to study findings; recommends changes to the study protocol to coincide with study goals and objectives.
Develops and implements procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Contributes to designing activities, policies and procedures to improve day to day efficiency of the recruitment and assessment components of the study and to ensure that staff members perform activities within established research protocol.
Arranges patient enrollment, determines patient eligibility and obtains informed consent.
Develops study subject referral sources; designs and develops outreach programs.
Collaborates with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegates tasks and supervises the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0416.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in clinical nursing or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Deep knowledge of informed consent processes, with proven ability to clearly communicate and execute consent with study participants.
Extensive current clinical skills including physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration, and basic emergency management; ALS or BLS and AED certification required.
Advanced knowledge of HIPAA and HIC regulations, with demonstrated expertise in medical record abstraction and accurate electronic recording of clinical and laboratory data.
Proven ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent, and pediatric study subjects; expertise in specimen transport and preparation for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance.
Strong command of electronic data capture systems, including Epic, with a proven track record of maintaining accurate, timely, and complete records for study enrollment and data collection.
Exceptional organizational skills with demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks at a high level of proficiency; strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations.

Substantial prior experience in clinical research.
Demonstrated expertise in interpreting clinical physiologic data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Proven biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.
Proficiency with internet and standard computer applications.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the clinical and regulatory aspects of research nursing.
cond_0427.responsibilities:
Evaluates and assesses subject's suitability for inclusion in studies; develops and modifies procedures according to study findings; recommends changes to the study protocol to coincide with study goals and objectives.
Develops and implements procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Contributes to designing activities, policies and procedures to improve day to day efficiency of the recruitment and assessment components of the study and to ensure that staff members perform activities within established research protocol.
Arranges patient enrollment, determines patient eligibility and obtains informed consent.
Develops study subject referral sources; designs and develops outreach programs.
Collaborates with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegates tasks and supervises the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0427.requirements:
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants. Current clinical skills to include physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations. Ability to work independently, display excellent communication skills.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent and pediatric study subjects when needed, transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol, when necessary. Prepares specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance, when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion. Proven ability with maintaining accurate, timely and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection with adaptability in Epic as well as other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task with a high level of proficiency. Demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Previous experience in interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients highly desirable.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations required.
Computer skills including familiarity with internet.
Previous experience in clinical research strongly preferred.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.
cond_0427.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

cond_0447.intro: As a member of [Company name masked]'s research support services team, you will be regularly working with research subjects, clinical investigators, and research support staff to deliver high-quality clinical nursing care throughout study participation. A large part of the role is staying in direct contact with study participants, collaborating with investigators and administration, and actively contributing to participant education, protocol-directed activities, and data collection.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Regularly evaluate and assess subjects' suitability for inclusion in studies; develop and modify procedures based on study findings; communicate recommendations for protocol changes to align with study goals and objectives.
Develop and implement procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Actively contribute to designing activities, policies, and procedures to improve day-to-day efficiency of recruitment and assessment, and connect with staff to ensure activities are carried out within established research protocol.
Arrange patient enrollment, determine patient eligibility, and engage directly with participants to obtain informed consent.
Develop study subject referral sources; design and develop outreach programs.
Collaborate closely and on an ongoing basis with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0447.requirements:
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants. Current clinical skills to include physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations. Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with colleagues and participants.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent and pediatric study subjects when needed, transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol, when necessary. Prepares specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance, when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion. Proven ability with maintaining accurate, timely and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection with adaptability in Epic as well as other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task with a high level of proficiency. Demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Previous experience in interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients highly desirable.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations required.
Computer skills including familiarity with internet.
Previous experience in clinical research strongly preferred.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in the State of [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.

cond_0476.responsibilities:
Evaluate and assess subjects' suitability for inclusion in studies; determine and modify procedures based on study findings; recommend protocol changes to align with study goals and objectives.
Develop and implement procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Lead the design of activities, policies, and procedures to improve day-to-day efficiency of recruitment and assessment, and ensure staff perform activities within established research protocol.
Direct patient enrollment, determine patient eligibility, and obtain informed consent.
Develop study subject referral sources; design and execute outreach programs.
Lead coordination with multidisciplinary researchers to integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0476.requirements:

Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in the State of [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Current clinical skills including physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration, and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations.
Ability to work independently and display excellent communication skills.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent, and pediatric study subjects when needed; transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol; prepare specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion.
Proven ability maintaining accurate, timely, and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection, with adaptability in Epic and other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize, and multi-task with a high level of proficiency; demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations.
Computer skills including familiarity with the internet.
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience in clinical research.
Previous experience interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.

You will drive the Center's mission of delivering high-quality service to clinical investigators and study participants, leading collaboration with research support staff, clinical investigators, and administration to ensure accurate participant education, protocol-directed activities, and data collection — working directly in a nursing capacity with current essential clinical skills.
cond_0485.responsibilities:
Evaluate and assess subjects' suitability for inclusion in studies; develop and modify procedures based on study findings; determine and recommend changes to the study protocol to align with study goals and objectives.
Develop and implement procedures and data quality assurance standards for safety monitoring components of studies.
Lead the design of activities, policies, and procedures to improve day-to-day efficiency of recruitment and assessment, and ensure staff perform activities within established research protocol.
Direct patient enrollment, determine patient eligibility, and obtain informed consent.
Develop study subject referral sources; design and execute outreach programs.
Lead collaboration with multidisciplinary researchers to coordinate research programs that integrate new advances in clinical trials.
Delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers.
May perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0485.requirements:
Bachelor's of Science Degree in Nursing and four years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to clearly communicate and execute informed consent with study participants. Current clinical skills to include physical assessment, health history, venipuncture, IV site establishment, access and care, ECG and vital sign acquisition, medication administration and basic emergency management with ALS or BLS and AED certification.
Ability to perform medical record abstraction and record clinical and laboratory data accurately and electronically according to HIPAA and HIC regulations. Ability to work independently, display excellent communication skills.
Ability to perform phlebotomy on adult, adolescent and pediatric study subjects when needed, transport specimens to and from clinical laboratories per protocol, when necessary. Prepares specimens for shipment to central laboratories under EHS guidance, when necessary.
Ability to communicate with the data coordinating center and respond to requests for information in a timely and complete fashion. Proven ability with maintaining accurate, timely and complete records regarding study enrollment and data collection with adaptability in Epic as well as other electronic data capture systems.
Ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task with a high level of proficiency. Demonstrated problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Previous experience in interpreting clinical physiologic data in hospitalized patients, including ICU patients highly desirable.
Up-to-date training in biosafety and human subject regulations required.
Computer skills including familiarity with internet.
Previous experience in clinical research strongly preferred.
Licensure as Registered Nurse in the State of [Location masked] or [Location masked] license eligible.
Experience interpreting clinical data in ambulatory and hospitalized patients, including ICU patients.
Demonstrated ability to gain biosafety and regulatory proficiencies.
